en.title: Toast with Chicken

steps.n1: Carefully flatten the slice of toast using a rolling pin.
steps.n2: Sauté the onion in oil, then mix it with a little of the shredded chicken seasoned with salt, pepper, spices, and thyme.
steps.n3: Stuff the toast with a small amount of this mixture.
steps.n4: Roll the toast into a finger shape, then coat it in flour, then egg, and finally breadcrumbs.
steps.n5: Place in the refrigerator until firm, then fry in hot oil.
steps.n6: Repeat this process according to the number of family members.

Repeat this process according to the number of family members.
